description:

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

title: Director, Corporate Legal (M&A)
description:

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As the senior transactions counsel within Corporate Legal, you’ll own high-impact corporate transactions across Airwallex globally. You’ll lead private-company fundraising and financing transactions, including equity and equity-linked deals, from term-sheet development and definitive agreements through diligence, negotiation, closing and post-close actions. You’ll design and execute domestic and cross-border M&A and strategic transactions, including acquisitions of licensed fintech entities and other strategic assets, while advising on structure, documentation, regulatory and licensing considerations, closing mechanics and post-closing integration. You’ll also shape secondary sales, corporate governance, capital structure, intragroup reorganisations and corporate actions, ensuring Airwallex’s global entity and ownership structure supports its licensing, tax, regulatory and commercial objectives.

- Structure secondary sales and private-company liquidity programs for existing shareholders, employees and early investors, including tender offers, transfer restrictions, ROFR/ROFO mechanics and stakeholder approvals.

- Select, manage and direct external counsel across multiple jurisdictions, holding them to a high bar for quality, commerciality, speed and cost.

- Build scalable transaction processes, playbooks, templates and approval frameworks, thoughtfully using LegalTech and AI to increase speed, consistency and deal capacity.

You’ll work from our San Francisco or New York office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- U.S. legal qualification, or foreign equivalent, and an active license to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

- Strong working knowledge of U.S. corporate and securities law as applied to private companies, particularly private-company fundraising, secondary transactions and corporate governance.

- Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior executives, investors and cross-functional stakeholders, providing clear, commercially grounded and risk-balanced advice in fast-moving environments.

title: Sales Manager (Crypto/Fintech/Payments)
description:
Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Their operation is fully legal and compliant, with licenses in multiple countries and jurisdictions globally. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.
﻿
Role Overview
Our client is seeking an ambitious Sales Manager to accelerate client acquisition, grow settlement volumes, and strengthen corridor activity within their Digital Assets business line. This role is hands-on and results-driven - ideal for someone with a strong network across PSPs, OTC traders, crypto exchanges, or financial institutions who can drive business volume directly into our clients network. You will own the full sales lifecycle - from prospecting and negotiation to onboarding and activation - and will play a key role in achieving the company’s TPV and revenue targets.
Job Type: Full Time
Workplace: Remote
Requirements

• 5-10 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management within fintech, FX/payments, or digital assets.

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue and volume targets.

• Strong network across OTC trading desks, PSPs, remittance firms, or exchanges.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills; able to handle complex deals independently.

• Understanding of stablecoins, FX, cross-border settlement, and liquidity management preferred.

• Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a fast-moving, execution-driven environment.

• Fluent in English (Mandarin, Thai, Tagalog, Bahasa, or other Asian languages a plus).

‍Responsibilities
Business Development & Revenue Growth

• Acquire new clients and partners across PSPs, OTC desks, exchanges, and remittance firms.

• Drive cross-border settlement volume and liquidity into Lightnet’s stablecoin and payment rails.

• Manage the full sales cycle: From lead generation, proposal, and negotiation to contract and onboarding.

• Meet or exceed assigned monthly and quarterly Total Payment Volume (TPV) and Net Revenue Contribution (NRC) targets.

• Identify and pursue new corridor opportunities (e.g., THB↔PHP, PHP↔IDR, CNY/CNH, SGD corridors).

Account Management & Relationship Building

• Maintain and grow relationships with key institutional clients and partners.

• Ensure successful onboarding and operational readiness with Treasury, Compliance, and Onboarding teams.

• Work closely with Product and Operations to improve partner experience and address client needs.

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

• Monitor competitive activity, partner feedback, and emerging market trends in digital assets and cross-border payments.

• Contribute to corridor strategy, pricing optimization, and market expansion initiatives.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Commercial leadership to execute go-to-market campaigns and partnership launches.

Benefits

• Competitive salary with open-ended performance-based commission.

• Opportunity to work at the forefront of fintech innovation in cross-border digital asset settlement.

• Collaborative, high-performance culture with regional career growth opportunities.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team https://building.nubank.com.br/design/.

Once here, you will:

- Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

- Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

- Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

- Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

- Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

- Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

- Experience in digital products;

- Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

- Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

- Chance of earning equity at Nu

- Extended maternity and paternity leaves

- Health and life insurance

- NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

- Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

- NuLanguage - Our language learning program

- Vacations of 15 workdays

- Gym partnership

- Work-from-home Allowance

- Parental Consultancy

- Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

- Hybrid (3 days in-office per week): Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence-enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.g

title: Lead VBC Quality Consultant

The Lead VBC Quality Consultant serves as the strategic quality advisor for an assigned portfolio of Value-Based Care organizations. The role analyzes performance, identifies opportunities, develops quality improvement strategies, and partners with provider organizations to improve Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and other quality outcomes. The consultant serves as the primary quality liaison between internal teams and external provider partners and is accountable for coordinating execution, monitoring results, and escalating barriers.

title: Corporate Counsel, Prediction Markets

It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.
The Crown Is Yours
As Corporate Counsel supporting DKeX, you'll help build the legal framework behind one of DraftKings' newest regulated businesses. You'll provide strategic legal guidance to the teams developing and operating our designated contract market while supporting related regulated exchange and clearing initiatives. Working at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and product development, you'll help build the legal foundation for a new regulated marketplace while translating complex regulatory requirements into practical business guidance. You'll join a growing Legal Team where you'll help establish the legal and regulatory foundation for an evolving business at the forefront of regulated prediction markets.
What you'll do as Corporate Counsel, Prediction Markets

• Serve as the primary legal partner supporting DKeX and related regulated exchange and clearing initiatives.

• Advise business stakeholders on legal and regulatory issues arising under the Commodity Exchange Act and Commodity Futures Trading Commission regulations.

• Draft, review, and maintain exchange rule, policies, governance materials, and other legal documentation supporting the operation and evolution of regulated market infrastructure.

• Provide legal guidance on regulatory filings, rule submissions, and other matters supporting the ongoing operation of DKeX and related regulated exchange and clearing initiatives.

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Market Operations, Compliance, Finance, Information Technology, and other cross-functional teams to support the development, launch, and operation of regulated products and services.

• Monitor legislative, regulatory, and industry developments affecting derivatives markets and advise internal stakeholders on emerging legal risks, obligations, and opportunities.

• Manage outside counsel and coordinate legal support across specialized regulatory matters when appropriate.

• Develop practical legal guidance, scalable processes, and internal resources that empower business teams to make informed decisions while maintaining compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

What you'll bring

• Juris Doctorate Degree from an accredited institution with excellent academic credentials.

• At least five years of legal experience, ideally a mix of law firm, in-house, or government/regulatory experience.

• Experience advising clients on financial services regulation, derivatives markets, exchange regulation, or other highly regulated industries.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex regulatory frameworks and provide practical, business-oriented legal advice.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain sophisticated legal concepts to technical and non-legal audiences.

We sit at the intersection of clinical provider and technology company. Our CQC-registered service is powered by Medefer ’s own electronic health record and referral platform, connecting GPs, consultants, diagnostic providers and hospitals into a single coordinated system. This approach has won multiple national awards for elective recovery, innovation and impact, and we now serve both NHS partners and private patients across the UK.

证券交易产品对细节要求很高：订单逻辑、费用、交易时段、资产、融资融券和风险提示中任何一个断点，都可能变成用户困惑或线上风险。这个岗位要设计稳定、清晰、易用的美股及相关交易产品体验，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。你会把市场规则、用户需求、合规约束和项目交付整合成一条清晰的产品路线。未来 12-24 个月，你需要交付能提升转化、留存、交易效率和用户信任的核心交易模块。

• 规划并设计交易产品模块，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、融资融券、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。

• 安全使用 AI 工具完成竞品研究、需求梳理、PRD 撰写、原型构思、数据分析和金融产品机会发现。

【你需要带来什么】

Non-negotiables

• 你交付过生产级金融交易产品，并完整经历过调研、设计、上线、复盘和持续迭代。

Bonus

• 你熟悉港股市场、跨境投资、互联网券商产品，或证券、基金等金融资格体系。

title: Internship in instrumentation of a flapping wing via flexible electronic gauge - 4 to 6 months
description:

Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you ?
As an intern, you will perform innovation and research activities in the field of soft electronics for flapping wing drone’s applications. Within this centre of Microelectronics and the flexible electronics department, you will combine your passion for science and for societal impact.
The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m²-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Flexible electronics can be used for mechanical sensing applications such as measuring the deformation of lightweight and flexible structures. Within this project, a flexible strain gauge will be integrated onto the wing of a bird-like flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle (FWMAV) in order to measure its deformation during flapping.
The work will focus on the integration and characterization of the strain gauge on the flapping wing. A dedicated test bench will be developed to operate the wing under controlled flapping conditions, while the strain gauge signal will be acquired in real time and transmitted to a computer for visualization, storage and analysis.
The electrical measurements will be compared with an independent optical measurement of the wing deformation, using for example a high-speed camera or a motion capture system, in order to validate and calibrate the sensor. The influence of the added instrumentation on the mechanical and dynamic behavior of the bare wing will also be investigated.

An important part of the work will be:
· Integrate of a strain gauge on an X-Fly wing (an early version of the gauge will be provided)
· Set up a test bench that allows the drone's wing to flap under controlled conditions
· Acquire the gauge signal in real time and transmit it to a computer (e.g., via an Arduino or Teensy) for display, storage, and analysis
· Compare the electrical signal to an external measurement of deformation (e.g., using a high-speed camera, Vicon, or another available optical measurement system) to verify the strain gauge's operation and calibrate it
· Estimate the impact of adding the gauge on the dynamics of the naked wing

The scientific question at the heart of the internship will be “how to instrument a flapping wing, without significantly modifying its mechanical properties”
If time permits, the intern will also be able to study various instrumentation configurations (geometry, orientation, stack configuration, gauge positioning, etc.) and analyze their impact on both

Teton is building the predictive intelligence layer for senior care. Our AI and computer vision platform passively and privately understands what is happening across residents, staff and space, then turns it into actionable insight for frontline caregivers, operators and owners.

Founded in Copenhagen in 2020 and backed by a $20M Series A led by Plural, Teton is used every month by more than 10,000 care staff across the US and Europe. The role

You will translate deep regional and national reimbursement expertise into Teton 's product, so the care our platform observes is accurately reflected in assessments, documentation and revenue.

You will sit at the intersection of clinical operations, product and customers. Your work shapes what we build, how we prove value to SNF operators, and how our clients capture the reimbursement their care already earns, compliantly.

What you'll do

Translate RAI and MDS expertise into product

• Serve as Teton 's subject-matter expert on the RAI Manual, MDS 3.0, PDPM, Section GG, Care Area Assessments and Quality Measures.

• Map what Teton 's platform observes (mobility, ADLs, sleep, falls, behaviors, staff interactions) to MDS items, look-back periods and PDPM components.

• Define clinical and reimbursement requirements with product, data science and engineering; write specs, review models and validate outputs against real assessments.

• Monitor CMS rule changes, RAI Manual updates, Five-Star and SNF VBP changes, and state Medicaid case-mix methodologies, and turn them into product roadmap input.

Protect accuracy and compliance

• Ensure every reimbursement-related insight Teton delivers is defensible, audit-ready and supported by documentation.

• Build guardrails that prevent upcoding and flag under-capture, so clients capture accurate reimbursement, not inflated reimbursement.

• Advise on PEPPER, TPE, RAC and survey risk in how features are designed and positioned.

Drive client outcomes

• Partner with SNF operators' MDS coordinators, DONs, administrators and regional clinical reimbursement leaders to deploy Teton into their workflows.

• Quantify impact on case-mix index, PDPM rates, Medicaid CMI, quality measures and Five-Star ratings; build the ROI case for sales and renewals.

• Represent Teton at industry events and with clients, asset owners and partners as a credible clinical reimbursement voice.

Build internal capability

• Train Teton 's commercial, customer success and product teams on SNF reimbursement fundamentals.

• Develop playbooks, education content and clinical validation protocols as we scale across US portfolios.

What you bring

• 5+ years of direct involvement in national-level MDS and SNF revenue oversight, such as a corporate or multi-region Director/VP of Clinical Reimbursement role at a multi-facility SNF operator.

• Expert, current knowledge of the RAI Manual, MDS 3.0, PDPM, Section GG, and Medicare Part A and Medicaid case-mix reimbursement.

• Working knowledge of state Medicaid case-mix systems across multiple states, and how regional practices differ.

• Track record of improving MDS accuracy, case-mix capture and reimbursement outcomes across a portfolio of facilities.

You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote, LATAM
Job Type: Full-time
What you'll do
1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

• Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

• Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

• After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

• Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

• Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

• Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

• Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

• Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

• Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

• Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

• Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

• Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

5. Book travel

• Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

• Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

• Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

• Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

• Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

• Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Mission Systems Integration Engineer, you will be responsible for both lab & field integration and test of payloads, subcomponents, amplifiers, and antennas. You will leverage your expertise in electronics/RF design, testing, and troubleshooting to rapidly test & integrate both internal and third-party built RF systems. You will develop test set-ups that allow for the validation of device performance using state-of-the-art RF equipment, such as spectrum and network analyzers. You will support flight test events and large-scale, customer facing validation exercises. This will require taking ownership of end to end system test and working across various Anduril internal teams to appropriately integrate capabilities. If you are someone who enjoys building and delivering compelling next-generation autonomous capabilities and supporting actual vehicle integration, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Test RF systems (power measurements, pulse response/synchronization, network analysis, environmental & stress testing, etc.)

• Drive air vehicle integration and checkout efforts (EMI/interference testing, installed performance testing, data analysis)

• Validate system performance in close cooperation with design & system engineers

• Work closely with AD&S teams to successfully integrate & deliver high-performance systems to our customers

• Communicate results in multiple forms internally and externally

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Currently possesses or is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Communications, sensors, and effector domain expertise in RF based systems (e.g. Radar, ESM, EW, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with RF test equipment and measurement techniques

• Experience in RF system integration and validation, the more the better

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Hands-on experience with both analog and digital systems integration.

• Ability to develop SW to enable closed-loop or automated testing of systems under test

title: Director of Engineering (Poland)
description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Engineering to lead our engineering team and drive innovation across client and internal projects. This role is integral to our organization’s success, requiring a visionary leader who can align engineering initiatives with business objectives, mentor a diverse and talented team, and deliver high-quality solutions that exceed client expectations. The ideal candidate will bring a proven track record of engineering leadership, exceptional technical expertise, and a passion for fostering collaboration and continuous improvement. If you are motivated by the opportunity to make a strategic impact, inspire teams, and deliver outstanding results in a fast-paced environment, we invite you to join our team.
Responsibilities

• Develop and oversee the strategic and operational aspects of the engineering department.

• Advocate for and implement efficient and innovative engineering solutions for clients.

• Manage the engineering team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship.

• Foster a collaborative and inspiring environment within the team.

• Coordinate with other department leaders to align engineering projects with business goals.

• Ensure all engineering projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client’s specifications.

• Define key performance indicators for team productivity, project/product delivery and quality

• Establish and maintain some mechanism for feedback

• Ensuring that feedback is addressed in a timely manner.

• Apply quality assurance processes to deliver high-quality engineering services.

• Ensure the team is trained to handle the needs of the market

• Ensure the team is cross-trained so they are more likely to be kept utilized

• Review and Identify project risks for client projects and internal initiatives

• Mentor and grow managers from within the team

• Hire new managers, QAs, developers and other staff where needed

• Interview new team members where needed

• Capable of stepping into projects as needed to resolve blockers

• Prevent the formation of knowledge silos

• Improve/Maintain interdepartmental collaboration

• Work with the R&D team on internal initiatives and manage the delivery of those initiatives

• Determine and ensure that the needs of the engineering team in general are met

• Be a sounding board for team members where necessary for technical and non-technical issues

• Assess team composition vs the needs of the organization

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, or a related technical field

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent technical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities

• A commitment to excellence and continued professional development

Preferred Qualifications

• Worked with Salesforce

• Worked in consulting firms

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

- Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

- Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients.

- A portfolio showcasing exceptional craft, systems thinking, and tangible business or brand impact

- Proven experience leading complex projects without relying on hierarchical authority

Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.

title: Member of Product Staff, Foundation Models & Post-Training
description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Abridge was founded to power deeper understanding in healthcare. Our ambient AI platform transforms clinical conversations into high-quality documentation and is expanding into clinical workflows such as coding, clinical decision support, and care navigation. The quality of these products depends on the models beneath them - and on our ability to improve those models using signals that only Abridge can access at scale.

We are hiring a Product Lead to partner with ML Science on Abridge's foundation-model and post-training work. You will help turn our proprietary corpus of clinical conversations, clinician edits, EHR context, and downstream actions into durable model capabilities.
